basic_details.offering_entity: Hamad Bin Khalifa University & Qatar Foundation
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Hamad Bin Khalifa University (Education City, Doha, Qatar)
basic_details.major_restrictions: College of Science & Engineering, College of Health & Life Sciences, College of Law, College of Islamic Studies, College of Public Policy, College of Humanities & Social Sciences.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~150 to 200 merit-based scholarships awarded annually across all colleges
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally; highly competitive; strong Pakistani representation in CSE and CHLS
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full regular duration of the program (Master's: 2 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years)

nationality_requirements: International students of all nationalities (including Pakistan) and Qatar residents
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: 16 years of education (Bachelor's degree) for Master's; 18 years (Master's degree) for PhD from an accredited institution with strong academic standing.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.00 / 4.00 CGPA; competitive admitted scholarship recipients typically hold 3.50+ / 4.00 CGPA.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Degree relevant to intended graduate field.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final semester of degree.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior research experience, publications, and professional achievements evaluated favorably.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 or TOEFL iBT minimum 79 (score validity 2 years).

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None for English-taught programs; Arabic required for Islamic Studies courses.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Merit-based financial aid; candidates apply for funding alongside university admission.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold multiple full scholarships concurrently.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver for the entire duration of the degree program.

admission_application_fee.details: HBKU application fee (QAR 400, ~PKR 30,000) paid by candidate on portal.

accommodation.details: Free single-occupancy student accommodation in Qatar Foundation Education City student housing residences.

monthly_stipend.details: Tax-free monthly living stipend paid directly to student.
monthly_stipend.amount: Master's: QAR 5,000 / month (~PKR 380,000 / month); PhD: QAR 7,500 / month (~PKR 570,000 / month)

airfare.details: Annual round-trip economy class flight between home city and Doha, Qatar.

visa_fee.details: Qatar student residence permit and visa fees sponsored by HBKU.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive health insurance provided by Hamad Medical Corporation / private coverage.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Covered from living allowance and lab research budget.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Conference travel funding accessible via Qatar National Research Fund (QNRF) projects and university travel grants.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Education City tram and shuttle transit free.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: Hamad Bin Khalifa University (Education City, Doha, Qatar).
participating_institutions: Hamad Bin Khalifa University (College of Science & Engineering, College of Health & Life Sciences, College of Public Policy, College of Law, College of Islamic Studies)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Premier research university in Qatar Foundation's Education City.
available_majors: Computer Science and Engineering, Cybersecurity, Data Analytics, Sustainable Energy, Sustainable Environment, Genomics & Precision Medicine, Biological and Biomedical Sciences, Exercise Science, Public Policy, International Law, Islamic Finance, Digital Humanities
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Apply for admission on the HBKU online portal; complete the financial aid / scholarship application section.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: College of Science & Engineering (Cybersecurity and Data Analytics) has highest applicant volume; early submission strongly advised.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Align your research proposal with Qatar National Vision 2030 pillars: Cyber Security, Energy Transition, Precision Health, and Water Security.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the HBKU online portal, select college and degree program, complete personal profile, and upload required documents.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Choose degree program and review admission requirements (Opens November).
2. Create account on HBKU online portal and complete application form.
3. Pay the QAR 400 application fee online.
4. Upload Statement of Purpose, academic transcripts, CV, and research proposal.
5. Designate two academic referees who submit online recommendation letters.
6. Submit before the international applicant deadline (February 1).
7. Departmental committees conduct academic review and video interviews in March.
8. Admissions and scholarship offers released in April/May.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated application: Financial aid considered during admissions review.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via secure electronic link sent by HBKU.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Interest detailing academic background, career objectives, and reasons for choosing HBKU.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Detailed research proposal (2-4 pages) required for PhD and research master's applicants.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Departmental faculty panel conducts 20-30 minute video interview via Microsoft Teams in March.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE optional but encouraged for STEM; IELTS Academic (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT (79+) mandatory.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Transcripts certified by Pakistani degree-granting institution; HEC and Qatar Embassy attestation required for visa.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed essay outlining academic background and motivation
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clearly articulated research and professional goals

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts for all university education showing credits and grades
Submitted directly by university research professors
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: From professors who supervised your BS/MS thesis

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: International applicant deadline is strictly February 1 each year (earlier than local Qatar resident deadline in March).

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Academic GPA, transcript performance, prestige of home university)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 30% (Prior publications, research proposal quality, laboratory skills)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: College Admissions Committees and HBKU Central Scholarship Award Committee.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Holistic review of academic credentials, research proposal, interview, and alignment with Qatar Foundation priorities.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~3,500 to 4,500 international applications across all colleges
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: High-performing graduates with solid foundational knowledge, research publications, and clear alignment with HBKU research groups.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani universities (NUST, LUMS, Quaid-i-Azam, GIKI, FAST, UET Lahore, Aga Khan University).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Egypt, Jordan, India, Lebanon, Nigeria, Palestine, Morocco.

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial agencies claiming they can guarantee HBKU scholarship awards.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Pay only the QAR 400 application fee directly on the official HBKU portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never work through agents; HBKU does not authorize external intermediaries.
hidden_costs_breakdown: HEC and Qatar Embassy attestation fees in Islamabad.
Initial pocket money before first stipend release.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You need Arabic. (Fact: Programs in Science & Engineering, Health, and Public Policy are taught 100% in English).
MYTH: The scholarship requires repayment. (Fact: HBKU scholarships are merit grants with NO repayment obligation).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some websites confuse HBKU with Qatar University; they are two separate institutions with distinct scholarship frameworks.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 / 4.00 and earn required credits each semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical residence and attendance in Education City, Doha, Qatar.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester grade review; academic probation leads to loss of scholarship.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: On-campus student employment permitted up to 20 hours/week; outside employment restricted under Qatar student visa rules.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates can seek employment in Qatar's research and industrial sectors post-graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Expulsion, academic failure, or voluntary withdrawal terminates funding.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly limited to the standard program duration (max 2 years for MS; max 4 years for PhD).
